body.name: \((\widehat{\boldsymbol D},\widehat\theta,\widehat{\boldsymbol\tau})\)
body.construction: For \(p\geq3\) and fixed \(\iota\), split wells independently within rows into \(N_A\) training and \(N_B\) inference wells and fix \(\preceq_{\mathfrak G}\). For each graph and data vector, obtain \(\operatorname{Sel}_{\boldsymbol d}(g)\) by successively taking the smallest coordinate among the compact set of global minimizers of \(Q_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}(\cdot;g)\). On training data choose the \(\preceq_{\mathfrak G}\)-least graph attaining the smallest selected objective. On inference data set \(\widehat\theta=\operatorname{Sel}_{\widehat{\boldsymbol D}}(\widehat g_B)\) and \(\widehat{\boldsymbol\tau}=\boldsymbol\tau(\widehat{\boldsymbol D},\widehat\theta;\iota)\). This exact lexicographic convention is deterministic and Borel measurable.
